prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent full-body character grouping for an existing felt stop-motion story animation.
Reference inputs: Image 1 supplies the exact Gunpowder horse, tack and mounted Ichabod identities. Image 2 supplies exact standing Ichabod appearance. Match these characters and handmade felt miniature aesthetic closely; create a new pose.
Primary request: Show ONE Ichabod standing on the ground beside ONE old horse Gunpowder BEFORE mounting. Remove the rider completely from the saddle; the saddle is EMPTY. Ichabod is a tall, very slender ADULT, in his brown broad-brim hat, dark teal coat, rust waistcoat, cream cravat, tan breeches and dark stockings and brown buckled shoes. He stands on the near side of the horse, to the LEFT of the horse's shoulder in the image, his whole silhouette largely readable. One hand holds the reins comfortably low, the other hand smooths his own coat down near waist level. His mouth is CLOSED with a subtle hopeful smile; no singing or grand gesture.
Horse: same thin tired dark brown/bay old horse, dark shaggy mane and tail, small pale blaze and brown leather bridle/saddle from reference. Side view cheated toward the viewer, facing right. Four coherent legs with exactly four hooves, all planted on the same flat ground plane as Ichabod's two shoes. Horse's back/saddle reaches approximately Ichabod's upper chest: adult-human scale, he must not look like a child. Stable standing pose, NOT walking.
Composition: entire horse from tail to ears, and Ichabod from hat to both shoes, in one wide isolated cutout. Generous clear transparent margins around every edge. No floor, no scene, no text, no panel.
Style: warm richly textured hand-felted doll miniature with soft studio light and crisp silhouette.
Constraints: TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Exactly one man and one horse. Empty saddle. No second rider, duplicate person, extra limbs, missing feet, impossible bent legs, or floating hooves. Keep exact costumes, faces and horse markings close to references.
inspection: Inspected generated full image. One Ichabod with closed mouth and low hands; one empty-saddled Gunpowder, four intact planted horse hooves and two intact human shoes. Full silhouettes and margins. Costume, face and horse match reference. Coherent standing preparation for a cut to mounted pose. No actual mount animation depicted.
